tasks.FirstMonthDownloads: Number of downloads in the first month (60).
tasks.SecondMonthDownloads: Calculating the number of downloads in the second month (3 times the first month).
tasks.ThirdMonthDownloads: Calculating the number of downloads in the third month (70% of the corrected second month's downloads).
tasks.TotalDownloads: Summing up the total number of downloads over three months.
